purpose: Describe resolving a situation without an otherwise necessary action.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Vない stem + ずに済む; する → せずに済む
Because I had a reservation, I did not have to wait.
There was a backup, so I did not have to reenter the data.
There is a library nearby, so I do not have to buy books.
formation: Vない stem + ずに済む; する → せずに済む
restrictions: Often expresses relief or an avoided burden.
mistake: する becomes せず, not しず.
